task.description: Design comprehensive tests for OBS-06 alerting hooks. Produce test specification and concrete test files that verify all acceptance criteria and edge cases: ERROR-duration trigger behavior, DLQ threshold crossing one-shot/re-arm semantics, scheduler lag trigger behavior, deterministic payload fields/correlation ID, and delivery retry policy (3 attempts exponential backoff with terminal structured logging). Include negative and regression cases to prevent duplicate firing while above threshold and to verify re-fire after recovery and re-cross. Ensure tests align with implemented modules introduced by BACKEND-DEV and are runnable by TEST-RUNNER.
acceptance_criteria: A complete OBS-06 test spec is created with traceability to requirement acceptance criteria
Test cases cover all trigger types, threshold crossing behavior, retries/backoff, and terminal failure logging
Test artifacts are placed in the correct test directories and reference existing harness conventions
Result clearly identifies execution targets for TEST-RUNNER

result.summary: Test specs and test code for OBS-06 are implemented with deterministic, requirement-traceable coverage for ERROR-duration triggers, DLQ/scheduler threshold crossing one-shot re-arm semantics, deterministic payload/correlation fields, bounded retry behavior, and DB-visible alert state/depth paths.
